With reference to the places reserved for non-EU and non-equivalent applicants, as indicated in Art. 4, admission to the programme takes place through two selection rounds. Applications may be submitted within the deadlines specified in the following table: 5 Selection Application period Available places Publication of results NC1 Until 30 April 2026 25 from 18 May 2026

Applications for admission must be submitted through the portal https://apply.unisi.it/courses/course/145-b-biotech-engineering-health , and must be accompanied by the following documentation: ● Valid identification document.
● Curriculum Vitae (CV). A CV summarizing the applicant’s educational background, skills, any work experience, and qualifications.

Diplomas and transcripts issued abroad must be official, i.e. bearing the stamp of the institution and the signature of the issuing authority. They must be issued in Italian or English (either language is acceptable). If issued in another language, they must be accompanied by a certified translation.

notes: Tuition: the pages state fees based on ISEE bands (a large table) and a country-based correction coefficient list that does not tie Morocco to any reduced group; no single figure or range for this programme and this student could be quoted. Application channel: the pages say to apply via apply.unisi.it (university portal), not Universitaly. Intakes: two selection rounds exist for non-EU applicants (NC1 until 30 April 2026, NC2 from 1 May 2026 to 18 September 2026).

evidence.quote: Applicants must demonstrate their knowledge of the English language by submitting a recognized language certification

In order to be admitted to the Degree Programme, applicants must hold a secondary school diploma or a qualification obtained abroad that is recognized as suitable for admission to Italian universities. In addition, a command of the English language at level B2 or higher, according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), is required.
